steps.content: When you open your eyes again, you're no longer at the crazy carnival.
You don't see the tentacles that were charging at you, nor do you hear the wild howling of monsters in their thousands.
No response. As expected.
But you sense that someone is standing behind you.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The Black Ring has broken out... And you've failed to stop it...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: I risked my life to save you, and you've failed to stop the Black Ring... All because you couldn't bring yourself to kill that monster...

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The FAC, the DisCity... they mean nothing to you! All you care about is those monsters under your command!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Because you're a monster yourself! The DisCity has become a hellish place, all thanks to you monsters!
Behind him, more instinctive shapes stagger to their feet: Sheriffs, reporters, officials, Syndicate gangsters...
They are marching over to you, zombie-like and full of menace.

steps.speaker: Dying Phantom
steps.content: Detestable monsters, abominable power, a bunch of lunatics...

steps.speaker: Dying Phantom
steps.content: Should've killed you. Special Combat Unit, that's ludicrous... It's a mistake to let you out. The MBCC is a joke!

steps.speaker: Dying Phantom
steps.content: It's you who brought Mania. It's you who brought about the breakout of the Black Ring. You're the tumor that plagues the city!

steps.speaker: Dying Phantom
steps.content: Why so quiet? You can't rebut, because all I'm saying is true!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No, because I know this is just an illusion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't the first time I've been inside a Black Ring. I know a thing or two about this kind of mental interference.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Show yourself, owner of the Black Ring. I want to talk to you, not the illusion.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Don't act like this has nothing to do with you! Who killed 036?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: He fought Black Rings all his life, and how did he die in the end?! He protected you for so long, and how did you treat him?!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Don't you feel repentant? Doesn't it pain you? Huh... Even that can't move you?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: That's what I figured. See? You don't care about our lives, mine or my brothers'.
He lunges at you, and you raise your arm to defend yourself when the shackles start to burn.
